summary: For multi-tier application deployments, add playbooks such as deploy_exampledotcom.yml alongside site.yml, reusing groups and keeping OS configuration separate from application deployment.
questions: Should application deployment be in the same playbook as OS configuration?
How do I organize playbooks for multi-tier deployments?

answer_card.title: Organizing deployment vs configuration
answer_card.answer_md: For multi-tier rollouts, add playbooks that hop between tiers (for example `deploy_exampledotcom.yml`) alongside `site.yml`. Since Ansible does both deployment and configuration, reuse your groups but keep OS configuration in separate playbooks or roles from application deployment.
